scope: Complete supplied five-page main, Figures 1–7, equations 1–3 and 40-entry bibliography. SI and cited full sources unreviewed.

bibliographic_scope.title: Synthesizing nanocrystalline LiMn2O4 by a combustion route
bibliographic_scope.authors: Daniela Kovacheva; Hristo Gadjov; Kostadin Petrov; Sankar Mandal; Mónica G. Lazarraga; Laura Pascual; J. Manuel Amarilla; Rosa M. Rojas; Pilar Herrero; José M. Rojo

preparation_scope.target_mass_basis: Reagent-charge calculation target, not measured recovered product yield
preparation_scope.purity: Reagent grade; fuel also called commercial sugar
preparation_scope.formal_equation_scope: Redox-valence stoichiometry. Actual lithium starting compound is Li2CO3 dissolved in dilute nitric acid; no separate LiNO3 charge is invented.
preparation_scope.ratio_basis: Total oxidizing and reducing valences F:O
preparation_scope.dissolution: Minimum dilute HNO3; acid amount/concentration and individual reagent masses unreported
preparation_scope.endpoint: Evaporated viscous mass becomes brownish-yellow foam; flame-free ignition gives black sponge-like voluminous product
preparation_scope.combustion_peak_temperature: Unmeasured; authors infer relative higher/lower temperature from impurity identity

anneal.scope: A portion of each P powder; fraction, ramps and physical batch IDs unspecified

samples.label: 2P
samples.phase: Spinel with Mn3O4; approximately 11 vol% Mn3O4 by PowderCell estimate

samples.label: 0.5A
samples.phase: Spinel with residual Mn2O3; excluded from further measurements

XRD.refinement: CelRef; numeric cell a is refined but no atomic coordinate set provided

TEM.support: Drops on holey carbon-coated copper grid

impedance.specimen: Cold-pressed pellet, sintered 700 °C for 3 h; exact atmosphere not separately specified
impedance.scope: Distinct measurement pellet; no inferred post-sintering TEM size/phase

electrochemistry.electrode: 72 wt% spinel (approximately 20 mg), 17 wt% MMM Super P carbon black, 11 wt% PVDF
electrochemistry.electrolyte: 1 M LiPF6 in EC/DMC, Merck; EC:DMC ratio/volume unreported
electrochemistry.assembly: Argon glove box; water strictly below 1 ppm
electrochemistry.scope: Rate conditions are not new powder syntheses; the source does not identify independent cell batches

composition_interpretation.second_label_scope: Additional arrow visible on TG curve; not substituted for Tc1 onset or interpreted as a new synthesis phase
composition_interpretation.site_scope: Author compositional/site model, not atomic refinement; 8a tetrahedral and 16d octahedral assignments retained

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 2–4, Lattice, TG and electrochemical composition discussion

electrical_models.phonon_scope: Literal source notation with unresolved exponent; associated cited IR result unreviewed, not a newly measured frequency
electrical_models.eq2: σT = ν0[e²c(1−c)/(kB R)] exp(−2αR) exp(−W/(kB T))
electrical_models.eq3_scope: Retain printed expression as context; do not execute it as validated fitting code or silently change exponent grouping
electrical_models.near_room_temperature_transition: No sharp conductivity jump and no DSC peak observed for 2A
electrical_models.reference_transition: Stoichiometric reference LiMn2O4: cubic Fd3m ↔ orthorhombic Fddd; not assigned as an observed 2A transition

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 3, Figure 4, equations 2–3 and DSC interpretation

electrochemical_context.figure_cycle_scope: Printed individual curve labels retained as context; no inferred independent cells or additional source rows

solid_state_comparator.reported_preparation: Authors prepared by solid-state reaction; reagents/conditions unreported

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 4, Figures 6–7 and discussion

source_interpretation.text: The authors attribute smaller particles and a narrower distribution at the higher sucrose loading to greater gas evolution that hinders coalescence and growth. This is an interpretation of the 1A/2A comparison, not a quantified gas flow or combustion temperature.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 2, TEM size-distribution discussion

source_interpretation.topic: Annealing purity has a documented exception
source_interpretation.text: The detailed XRD analysis reports residual Mn2O3 for 0.5A, which is excluded from further measurements. Only 1A and 2A are described as single-spinel patterns. Broad abstract/conclusion statements about pure annealed products do not erase this exception.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 1–2, 4, Abstract, Figure 1 discussion and conclusion

source_interpretation.text: TG/reference correlation gives x=0.05 in Li1+xMn2−xO4, lattice-parameter correlation gives x=0.06, and electrochemical capacity gives an estimated Li1.04Mn1.96O4. These are distinct author-derived composition estimates, not independently refined exact site coordinates.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 3–4, Thermal, chemical and electrochemical composition analyses

source_interpretation.text: The authors fit the 2A-derived pellet above 180 K using nearest-neighbor small-polaron hopping, and below 180 K using variable-range hopping. Model parameters are not new preparation variants; a separately prepared pellet is not assigned the powder TEM diameter.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 3, Figure 4 and equations 2–3

source_interpretation.text: Higher current is interpreted as restricting lithium exchange to the outer particle region. The authors relate the small-particle sample’s higher high-rate capacity to its size and its slow capacity fade to lithium excess. The solid-state comparator lacks a complete preparation in the supplied article.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 4, Figures 6–7 and rate/cycling discussion

claims.label: General summary
claims.statement: Abstract and concluding wording summarize annealing as yielding single-phase material.

claims.label: Sample-specific XRD
claims.statement: The detailed discussion and Figure 1d retain Mn2O3 in 0.5A and exclude it from further measurements.
claims.locator: Main PDF p.2, Figure 1d and adjacent text

source_conflicts.handling: Use the sample-specific impurity assignment for 0.5A. Do not label every annealed branch pure.

claims.label: Thermal estimate
claims.statement: TG onset/reference correlation gives x=0.05 and Li1.05Mn1.95O4.

claims.label: Lattice correlation
claims.statement: The source gives x=0.06 from the cubic lattice parameter versus composition relationship.

claims.label: Electrochemical estimate
claims.statement: First discharge corresponds to 0.88 Li and an estimated Li1.04Mn1.96O4.
claims.locator: Main PDF p.4, first-cycle capacity analysis

source_conflicts.handling: Retain the three evidence/model contexts in parallel; no averaging or assertion of measured exact occupancy.

claims.label: Printed frequency
claims.statement: The source prints an optical phonon frequency of 1.8 × 10−13 s−1 in the equation 2 explanation.
claims.locator: Main PDF p.3, paragraph below equation 2

source_conflicts.handling: Retain the literal exponent as a source model-context caveat. Do not silently correct it, treat it as a new measured frequency, or execute the model as validated code.
